hypothesis_origin.trigger: Observed temporal instability raised the explicit hypothesis that the 6H EMA50x200 continuation effect depends on directional market regime rather than calendar year.

candidate_identity_unchanged.exit: open after 6 completed 6H bars following entry

regime_classifier.information_cutoff: Only the most recent fully closed BTC 1D bar with close_time < candidate signal_close may be used.

event_regime_buckets.TREND_ALIGNED: bull cross in BULL_TREND OR bear cross in BEAR_TREND
event_regime_buckets.COUNTER_REGIME: bull cross in BEAR_TREND OR bear cross in BULL_TREND
event_regime_buckets.TRANSITION_CHOP: candidate cross when regime state is TRANSITION_CHOP
event_regime_buckets.MISSING: candidate cross when regime state cannot be certified

report: n, base mean, stress mean, PF and positive fraction by regime bucket
same metrics by historical block and regime bucket
cross direction x regime state matrix
concentration by symbol within each bucket
no historical bucket may trigger promotion

phase_B_prospective_forward.reason_for_first_signal_boundary: The 18:00-00:00 UTC 6H bar is the first full signal bar entirely after activation. No September 2026 pre-activation signal reconstruction is allowed.
evidence_categories: all exact EMA50x200 6H crosses after boundary

stronger_review_gate.purpose: separate V3 adjudication may be opened if evidence integrity is clean

mechanism_success_pattern.historical_diagnostic_only: TREND_ALIGNED should be materially stronger than TRANSITION_CHOP and COUNTER_REGIME if regime dependence is a plausible explanation.
mechanism_success_pattern.forward_confirmation: Prospective TREND_ALIGNED events must show positive base/stress economics and outperform the other frozen buckets without rule changes; exact adjudication is deferred to a separately frozen V3 review.
